notes.title: ALTF42 Final Stretch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43156896/2154632e156d90949609c25c6928e8a8c3722d3a.png[/img]

[h1]Dear loyal knights,[/h1]
We hope you had some fun with the previous event!
ALTF42 is now in the final spurts of development with its release just around the corner!
In this regard, we would like to provide an update to those of you who have been supporting the launch.

[h2]Development updates[/h2]
The final version will be a major quality upgrade.
Minor bugs in the Early Access version have been fixed, and the overall experience has been overhauled to make it more enjoyable.
We're also adding a final stage, so you can enjoy the end and the beginning of the brand-new ALTF42!
(Hope you enjoy the gigantic final stage!).

[h2]Price Increase[/h2]
We regret to say that we've increased the price before the launch.
The full-release version has many more features than the Early Access starting point.
We're incredibly grateful to those of you who have supported us with early access, and we're planning to offer a separate discount at launch.

Thanks again to everyone who has supported us so far!
See you at the starting line!

notes.title: Bug Fix - August 22, 2023
notes.content:
Bug fixes and convenience adjustments have been made.

1. Applied stability patches to the Steam Cloud system.
2. Corrected intermittent issue where guided missiles wouldn't periodically fly at the beginning of Adventure 06 map.
3. Modified specific section of Adventure 06 map where falling was not intended, ensuring non-fall behavior.
4. Adjusted instances of sporadic lateral flight while using the trampoline.
5. Altered the swap speed during unmanipulated pages of the ending sketch scene, preventing overly rapid progression.
6. Adjusted gambling den's winning multiplier from 2x to 3x and included a record of winnings on the final result page.

notes.title: ALTF42 updated. Take on your adventure right now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43156896/64555721195e45443f86337dfc0d65f3a50d6097.png[/img]

[h2]Don Qui arrived at ancient ruins faces a surprising new hardship.[/h2]

Face various traps and new enemies in the new stage.

In the ruins where terrifying traps await, overcome gigantic stone statues and immortal zombies and continue your great journey.

Will the chicken be able to return to a human through this journey?

[h3][b]- Clear the new map and continue the story.[/b][/h3]

[h2] Siege (Time Attack) update[/h2]

Siege system has renewed. Set a world record by challenge to the siege map is made up with several small stages. You can fly high in the sky after crossing over highways and going through sandstorm.

[h3][b]- Change in existing system[/b]

[b]- New 3 additional stages[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43156896/a24db81f77983d2b585b838515565284ff8cefbd.png[/img]



Other updates

- Addition of menu allows custom key setting

ALTF42 will be updated continuously in the future! Join us for an exciting adventure

notes.title: Bug fixes - April 8th, 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43156896/f4db8e64cd2f3cf3447cbe31fdc999260b7aacd6.png[/img]

1. Fixed the issue where the menu graphics settings were reset when the game was closed and reopened.
    (As a result of fixing this bug, the menu may be reset to its default settings.)

2. Fixed the issue where the bicycle view was not fixed forward when manipulating the bicycle on the course. 
    (The top and bottom of the camera can still be manipulated.)

3. Updated the memorial space (tomb) in the village for those who have not yet been added.

4. Changed it so that costumes are not reset when starting a new game.

->Currently, the cause of frame drops in the first village map or specific sections has mostly been identified, and we plan to proceed as quickly as possible in a systematic manner. We are also continuously fixing other bugs and planning updates, such as allowing players who have cleared the game before to choose old stages or adding siege battles. We will continue to work harder for a better game. Thank you.

notes.title: ALTF42 Patch_ April 2nd, 2023
notes.content:
ALTF42 patch has been completed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43156896/e52fba6ddc789f6ffe7367238c2fe5ae17bd5908.jpg[/img]

Here are the changes:

1. The previous large map has been divided into 7 different locations due to structural changes, which unfortunately requires starting anew and the reset of items and costumes.

2. The level design has been slightly modified.

3. The section transitions using cannons have been removed. If you reach a certain area, you can retry from that area.

4. You no longer return to the starting village, which means that items are hidden throughout the map. Don't worry, you'll be able to return to the village later in the game.

5. It seems that the frame rate has improved. We will continue to optimize the game.

6. For those who suffered through the initial version of ALTF42 or played it before the major changes, we have created a memorial space. Thanks to your feedback, we were able to make changes quickly. Thank you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43156896/09c87115a58d54f20172b418192eb7c2e9251ada.png[/img]

7. After the optimization is complete, the long linear map will be available for Time Attack in Siege mode.

All team members are doing their best to create a great game and fix bugs. We will continue to work hard to make the game as complete as possible for the official release. We will continue to provide quick and fun updates every month. Please join us until the end of Knight Donchi's story. Thank you for playing.

4. You no longer return to the starting village, which means that items are hidden throughout the map. Don't worry, you'll be able to return to the village later in the game.
5. It seems that the frame rate has improved. We will continue to optimize the game.

6. For those who suffered through the initial version of ALTF42 or played it before the major changes, we have created a memorial space. Thanks to your feedback, we were able to make changes quickly. Thank you.

notes.title: ATLF42 major patch
notes.content:
After continuously observing the streaming of the game following the Early Access release, we have decided to make significant changes to the direction of the game. We apologize for making such significant changes after the release without conducting extensive testing beforehand. We love this project and want to make it a success. We will update it as quickly as possible (aiming for April 1st, Pacific Standard Time).

We will divide the existing large level into seven smaller areas according to the storyline.
There will be changes to the cannon system and item shops.
Costumes will be obtained from hidden places on the map.
As the levels are divided, the dependence on coins and items will decrease.
The game plan will be changed to allow for quick stage updates in the future.
We promise to provide quick content updates that can compensate for the reduced playtime.
PS. We will create a small commemorative space (a tombstone) for the users and streamers who played the previous version in challenging environments. We will include the names or IDs of those who left Steam reviews and those who played or streamed the game in the comments. Thank you.
